## Scope and Authorization

Record the actual upfront owner response and scope receipt. State discovery scenario
(`evidence_only` or `requirements_led`), source (`iac`, `azure` or `combined`), allowed files,
tenant/subscription/resource-group boundaries and allowed read categories. No credential values.
State that permissions cover assessment reads only, not remediation or deployment.

## Business Context

For evidence-only mode, say that no business interview was requested; do not invent objectives.
For requirements-led mode, link captured requirements and preserve unknown targets.

## Evidence and Reporting Settings

List known evidence sources, dates, exclusions and collection limits.
Resolve cost reporting dates/currency/metric from the authorized settings.
Default proposal: last completed calendar month, preceding-month comparison and month-to-date,
with current-month forecast when available. IaC estimates need explicit assumptions, not tenant access.

## Deliverables and Acceptance

Link the WAF report, architecture diagram source/PNG/SVG and Cost Management report.
Record coverage and current run state in README/recall, not fabricated completion here.
Final bundle acceptance does not certify compliance, close workload gaps or authorize implementation.
